\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]\notesize
\item Notes: The task is ``prepare or assist in preparing simple to complex tax returns for individuals or small businesses'' (O*NET 13-2082.00, tax preparers), which Prompt 0 split into the six subtasks shown, with their shares of the task's time in percent. The subtask ratings are those of Claude Haiku 4.5 at each of the four stages, in the constraint-adjusted version that the paper uses: A is the percent of the subtask's time that AI could save, B is 1 if AI could complete the subtask alone to a professional standard and 0 otherwise, and C is 1 if people keep a durable advantage on the subtask. The task rating is the time-share-weighted mean of the subtask ratings, with B and C in percent of the task's time. The last two rows give the composite score at each stage for Claude Haiku 4.5 and averaged over the three models (Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, and GPT-5.6-luna), which rated the same six subtasks; the three-model composite is the task's exposure score. The ratings are made monotone across stages as described in Appendix~\ref{app:checks}.
